crossrefs.text: To Titus, my true child in our common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior.
To Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
In His own time He has made His word evident in the proclamation entrusted to me by the command of God our Savior.
To them God has chosen to make known among the Gentiles the glorious riches of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
“Go!” said the Lord. “This man is My chosen instrument to carry My name before the Gentiles and their kings, and before the people of Israel.
I am not writing this to shame you, but to warn you as my beloved children.
That is why I have sent you Timothy, my beloved and faithful child in the Lord. He will remind you of my way of life in Christ Jesus, which is exactly what I teach everywhere in every church.
Now I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered when I learn how you are doing.
holding on to faith and a good conscience, which some have rejected and thereby shipwrecked their faith.
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
But reject irreverent, silly myths. Instead, train yourself for godliness.
and will pay no attention to Jewish myths or to the commands of men who have rejected the truth.
But avoid foolish controversies, genealogies, arguments, and quarrels about the law, because these things are pointless and worthless.
Flee from youthful passions and pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace, together with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
For you, brothers, were called to freedom; but do not use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh. Rather, serve one another in love.
The entire law is fulfilled in a single decree: “Love your neighbor as yourself.”
Do you not know that the wicked will not inherit the kingdom of God? Do not be deceived: Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor men who submit to or perform homosexual acts,
nor thieves, nor the greedy, nor drunkards, nor verbal abusers, nor swindlers, will inherit the kingdom of God.
You must not lie with a man as with a woman; that is an abomination.
Why then was the law given? It was added because of transgressions, until the arrival of the seed to whom the promise referred. It was administered through angels by a mediator.
And, “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will become of the ungodly and the sinner?”
For this reason God gave them over to dishonorable passions. Even their women exchanged natural relations for unnatural ones.
For the time will come when men will not tolerate sound doctrine, but with itching ears they will gather around themselves teachers to suit their own desires.
The law came in so that the trespass would increase; but where sin increased, grace increased all the more,
On hearing this, Jesus told them, “It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick. I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners.”
For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.”
For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.
For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through Him.
As for anyone who hears My words and does not keep them, I do not judge him. For I have not come to judge the world, but to save the world.
Now to Him who is able to do immeasurably more than all we ask or imagine, according to His power that is at work within us,
to Him be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus throughout all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
to the only God our Savior be glory, majesty, dominion, and authority through Jesus Christ our Lord before all time, and now, and for all eternity. Amen.
Do not neglect the gift that is in you, which was given you through the prophecy spoken over you at the laying on of the hands of the elders.
When you are assembled in the name of our Lord Jesus and I am with you in spirit, along with the power of the Lord Jesus,
hand this man over to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, so that his spirit may be saved on the Day of the Lord.
But when we are judged by the Lord, we are being disciplined so that we will not be condemned with the world.
O Timothy, guard what has been entrusted to you. Avoid irreverent, empty chatter and the opposing arguments of so-called “knowledge,”
and the talk of such men will spread like gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,
I charge you in the presence of God and of Christ Jesus, who will judge the living and the dead, and in view of His appearing and His kingdom:
For the time will come when men will not tolerate sound doctrine, but with itching ears they will gather around themselves teachers to suit their own desires.
